n: Event <A Kazdelian Rescue> is now open

list: Unlock all the stories in A Kazdelian Rescue

With a great deal of effort, the departed ancestral spirits were finally sent back to the Furnace.
Perhaps this is an omen, signifying that the Soul Furnace's mission is nearing its end, or perhaps it foretells that after embracing nomadic city life, Kazdel will soon experience a profound rebirth.
During A Kazdelian Rescue event, obtain the Holiday HD66 outfit.

Catapult hands you a medal she made herself as a thank-you gift for organizing this beach party.
Just then, a water bomb splashed across your face—and you realize this was her tactic to catch you off guard. You raise your own water gun to retaliate.
